baseline.method: Independently executed original UBathy full two-video DMD/robust-dispersion result versus independent previous-day survey

coverage_qualification: Frozen from two complete independent original-only runs before the first cleaned full-field inversion. Original support5615; repeat5572; common5532; all83 lost sites lie within17.321m of original invalid support. A20m boundary band (four5m output spacings) permits at most2% loss of original support; all4410 fixed interior sites must remain valid. No GT error selected either support or boundary band. Exact-all provisional coverage is rejected by independent native stochastic evidence, not by a cleaned failure.
footprint_definition: Original measurement-supported5615-point mask sets required_coverage. Interior is its points more than20m from any originally invalid output point, fixed using coordinates/support only. Interior scores use all4410 locations, never a submitted subset. All submitted valid locations, including extras, are additionally survey-scored. Invalid zero sentinels are never treated as physical depths.
empty_submission_convention: Insufficient/all-invalid submitted support or incomplete mandatory interior yields cosine0 and maximum finite float64 error for the affected comparison, plus failing coverage; no NaN/Infinity.
alignment: None; no centering, shift, scale fit or GT-based crop.

interior_metric_provenance.normalization: RMS error / dynamic range of survey on4410 fixed interior points
interior_metric_provenance.boundary_rule: 0.9*originalNCC and1.1*originalNRMSE; this is a separately named metric with its own reference domain, not a changed full-domain threshold
